meta._doc: CMU mocap fighting-move segments for HIT PARADE. Frames are SOURCE frames at the take's fps (all 120). Frame 0 of every file is a T-pose calibration frame and is never used. start = windup start (hands: nearest guard / extension minimum; legs: last planted frame), contact = max reach (punch/kick) or the lying->standing transition (getup) / impact (fall), end = recovery (guard or foot planted again). class = final class after visual review (class_auto = geometric classifier). quality: clean | usable | junk | unreviewed (not viewed). Metrics: foot_drift_cm = max planted-foot horizontal path length in the window; pops = frames with a main joint > 3 cm off its 5-frame median; other_hand_peak_ms = combo contamination.
